verses.text: On day eight, Moses called Aaron, his sons, and Israel’s elders together. 👥
He told Aaron, “Bring a flawless calf from the herd for a sin offering and a flawless ram for a burnt offering. Present them before Yahweh. 🐂
“Tell Israel: ‘Bring a male goat for a sin offering, plus a one-year-old flawless calf and lamb for a burnt offering; 🐐
‘and bring a bull and ram for peace offerings to sacrifice before Yahweh, along with a grain offering mixed with oil. Yahweh will appear to you today.’” 🕊️
They brought everything Moses had commanded to the Meeting Tent. The whole community came close and stood before Yahweh. 🚶
Moses said, “This is what Yahweh commanded you to do, and then his glory will appear to you.” ✨

Moses told Aaron, “Step up to the altar. Offer your sin offering and burnt offering to make atonement for yourself and the people. Then present the people’s offering and make atonement for them, just as Yahweh commanded.” 🙏
Aaron stepped up to the altar and slaughtered the calf as his own sin offering. 🐂
His sons brought him the blood. He dipped a finger in it, put blood on the altar’s horns, and poured the rest at its base. 🩸
He burned the fat, kidneys, and liver covering from the sin offering on the altar, just as Yahweh had commanded Moses. 🔥
He burned the meat and hide with fire outside the camp. 🔥
Aaron slaughtered the burnt offering. His sons brought him the blood, and he splashed it around the altar. 🩸
They handed him the burnt offering piece by piece, including its head, and he burned it on the altar. 🔥
He washed the inner parts and legs, then burned them with the burnt offering on the altar. 💧
Aaron brought the people’s offering. He slaughtered their sin-offering goat and presented it for sin just like the first one. 🐐
He brought the burnt offering and presented it according to the rule. 🔥
He brought the grain offering, took a handful, and burned it on the altar along with that morning’s burnt offering. 🌾
Aaron also slaughtered the bull and ram as the people’s peace offerings. His sons brought him the blood, and he splashed it around the altar. 🩸
They brought the bull and ram’s fat, fat tails, fat covering the inner parts, kidneys, and liver coverings, 🐂
and placed the fat on the breasts. Aaron burned the fat on the altar. 🔥
As Moses had commanded, Aaron waved the breasts and right thigh before Yahweh as a presentation offering. 🙌
Aaron raised his hands toward the people and blessed them. Then he came down after presenting the sin, burnt, and peace offerings. 🙏
Moses and Aaron went into the Meeting Tent, came back out, and blessed the people. Then Yahweh’s glory appeared to everyone. ✨
Fire came from Yahweh’s presence and consumed the burnt offering and fat on the altar. When everyone saw it, they shouted and fell facedown. 🔥
